high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a Twitter post by Alexandr Wang (@alexandr_...), which was made 19 hours ago. The tweet discusses the expansion of Meta's Omnilingual Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) to support over 1,600 languages, including 500 that were previously unsupported. This is presented as a significant step towards truly universal AI. Below Alexandr Wang's tweet, there is a reply from "AI at Meta" (@AIatMeta), which was posted 21 hours ago. The reply introduces Meta Omnilingual ASR, describing it as a suite of models providing ASR
